framework.name: Governance, Economic Management and Human Rights
framework.description: Governance is all encompassing and refers to the systems in place to govern all aspects of society. Under this strategic priority, political, human rights and economic management of resources are explored for the advancement of the welfare of the people of The Gambia.

children.name: Outcome 1.1 - By 2021, accelerate inclusive and sustainable economic growth to reduce poverty and inequality for the vulnerable groups.
1.1.1 Increased national capacity and private sector competitiveness for inclusive employment
children.description: The output include support to skills development, entrepreneurship training and provision of business development services, access to finance. it also include support to MSMEs and institutional to TVET institutions and other training service providers to enhance quality and relevance of trainings.

children.name: 1.1.2 Capacities of institutions strengthened for inclusive economic planning and management
children.description: This output include support for different poverty reduction strategies, interventions , policies / strategies development and surveys to support inform influence decision making and accelerate development to bridge the socio-economic inequality gaps, increase livelihoods and employment creation.

children.name: Strengthened national and subnational institutions to achieve structural transformation of productive capacities that are sustainable and  employment and livelihood intensive.

Outcome 1.2 - By 2021 Institutional reforms implemented to ensure rule of law and guarantee the protection of the human rights of all including access to justice, gender equality, access to basic services and democratic participation in decision-making processes.
children.description: To ensure gurantee of Human Rights of PLHIVs and Key population incuding access to Jusatice , Gender Equality., and access to HIV services and  ensure their participation democratic decision making processes

children.name: 1.2.1 Electoral management bodies and parliament enabled to perform core functions for improved accountability, participation and representation, including for peaceful transitions.
children.description: The project is designed to strengthen the Gambia’s key democratic institutions and processes through a functional and inclusive electoral processes that ensure the peaceful conduct of the 2021 Presidential and  2022 National Assembly  elections. The main objectives of the Electoral Assistance project are  to enhance transparency is enhanced throughout the electoral process, inclusive participation is supported to strengthen the elections credibility throughout the political process., accountability is enhanced throughout the electoral process, capacity of electoral stakeholders is strengthened and dialogue and coordination mechanisms for early warning and early response to election-related violence are implemented throughout the electoral cycle.

children.name: 1.2.2 Enhanced institutional capacity of the justice and security  system to protect human rights and deliver accessible, efficient and accountable justice and security to all, especially women and vulnerable groups
1.2.3 Frameworks developed for accountability, transparency and effective engagement of civil society in national development
children.description: Improving governance and fighting corruption - Institutional reforms implemented to ensure rule of law and guarantee the protection of the human rights of all, including access to justice, gender equality, access to basic services, and democratic participation in decision-making process - IOM continued to provide support to the National Coordination Mechanism on Migration (NCM). The support in 2020 included: establishing a fully functional NCM Secretariat at the Office of the Vice President (OVP) with donation of equipment; and operationalizing 6 out of the 8 Thematic Working Groups (TWGs) under the NCM.

framework.name: Human Capital Development
framework.description: The Gambia faces human development related challenges, chief among which are in the areas of human resource capacity, weak monitoring mechanism (especially timely data collection), poor quality of services provided at all levels and inequitable access to these basic social services.

children.name: Outcome 2.1 - Increased access to inclusive and equitable quality and relevant education for all with special focus on the most vulnerable.

Children attending pre- and primary school receive a safe and nutritious meal every day they attend school to contribute to their basic food and nutrition needs and increase their school enrolment and attendance
children.description: School-age children and adolescents have access to school-based health and nutrition packages

children.name: 2.1.1 All children aged 4 – 6 years benefit from formal and informal quality early learning opportunities for enhanced school readiness.
2.1.2 Children excluded from mainstream education, including those affected by humanitatrian situations, exercise their right to a quality and inclusive education

framework.name: Sustainable Agriculture, Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change Management
framework.description: The Gambia has limited land resources of which only about 54% of the total land area or about 558,000 Ha is cultivable. The country is also one of the Sub-Saharan African countries most affected by land degradation and deforestation. The agricultural and natural resource sector comprising of crops, livestock, fisheries and forestry production is one of the key drivers for economic growth in The Gambia.

3.1.1 Capacity of farmers and fisher-folks strengthened to improve crop, livestock and fisheries production and productivity to enhance livelihood
children.description: Farmers and fisher-folks capacities built through, technical support, provision of agriculture and fisheries inputs, exchange visits and operation centre to facilitate trainings and demonstrations

children.name: 3.1.3 Crisis-affected beneficiaries receive timely and adequate food or CBT to meet their food and nutrition requirements
children.description: Provide humanitarian assistance to farmers (e.g. distribution of seeds)

children.name: 3.1.4 Capacity of community organizations and beneficiaries strengthened on production, post-harvest handling, processing and marketing of fish
children.description: strengthen capacities of beneficiaries on fisheries and aquaculture production and value chain addition

children.name: 3.1.5 Strengthened capacity of agricultural, livestock and fisheries institutions for improved service delivery and improved capacity of  producers
children.description: strengthen institutional capacities to enhance service delivery

children.name: 3.1.6 Increased capacity of value-chain actors in value addition and managing ANR enterprises that promote youth and women’s employment.
children.description: capacities of value chain actors enhanced for employment creation and income generation.
